name: Heart of the Glacier

abilities.name: Aberrant Ground
abilities.description: The ground in a 10-foot radius originating from the heart is Difficult Terrain.

abilities.name: Cold Absorption
abilities.description: Whenever the heart is subjected to cold damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of hit points equal to the cold damage dealt.

abilities.name: Siege Monster
abilities.description: The heart deals double damage to objects and structures.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The heart makes two Slam attacks. It can replace one attack with a use of Toppling Surge.

actions.name: Slam
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +9 to hit, reach 10 ft., one target. Hit: 22 (4d8 + 4) bludgeoning damage plus 13 (3d8) cold damage.

actions.name: Killing Wake (Recharge 5-6)
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must make a DC 17 Constitution saving throw, taking 71 (13d10) cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a failed save, the target is also deafened until the end of its next turn.

actions.name: Toppling Surge
actions.description: Each creature in a 30-foot cone must succeed on a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw or be knocked prone.

generation.userConcept: a glacier's heart given legs, trailing a wake of killing cold

clauses.text: trailing a wake of killing cold

generation.cite: composition after Clay Golem / Stone Golem (CR 9-10)
